title: 💸 How to Withdraw
msg: Go to My > Withdraw > Enter amount (min UGX 30,000) > Select Mobile Money > Confirm. Withdrawals processed in 5-30 mins, 8am-8pm daily. 10% fee applies.

title: 💰 How to Deposit
msg: Go to My > Recharge > Enter amount > Copy Till Number > Pay via MTN/Airtel. Upload screenshot. Balance updates in 2-5 mins. Contact support if delay.

title: 🤖 How AI Income Works
msg: AI Income is daily profit from your active miners. CODEX-A1 earns 8k/day, A2 18k/day, A3 40k/day, A4 90k/day. Income auto-credited at 00:00 EAT daily for 100 Days.

title: 👥 Team Income Explained
msg: Invite friends with your link: Level 1 = 15%, Level 2 = 5%, Level 3 = 2% of their daily income. Team Count shows total active invites. Team Income updates instantly.

title: 📨 How to Invite & Earn
msg: Go to My > Invite > Copy link > Share on WhatsApp/Facebook. When friend buys miner, you get bonus. Invite Count shows total users joined via your link.

title: 🤖 LIVE Robots Update
msg: All A-series miners now use real AI robots! 7-80 robots per miner working 24/7 in our data center. Watch LIVE video on AI page. HASH rate updates in real-time.

title: 📅 Lock Period Changed to 100 Days
msg: All miners lock changed from 120 to 100 Days for faster ROI. Your current miners will also finish in 100 Days. Total income unchanged.

title: 🔒 Security Notice
msg: Never share password or OTP. CODEX700 staff will NEVER ask for your password. Enable 2FA in My > Settings. Contact official support only via Chats tab.

title: 🆕 New Miners A5 & A6 Launched
msg: CODEX-A5 (UGX 3.5M) 160k/day and A6 (UGX 5M) 250k/day now available. 52-80 robots, 22-35kW power. Limited stock!

title: 🎁 Daily Raffle Guide
msg: Go to Raffle tab > Buy ticket UGX 5k > Win up to UGX 500k daily. Draw at 8pm EAT. Winners auto-credited. Check results in Raffle > My Tickets.
